decision: read model and effort from Claude Code's status line input, through a wrapper that passes the same input on to the status line command Manuel already uses
why: the status line JSON is documented and carries model.id, model.display_name, and effort.level live; hooks carry the model only on some SessionStart events and the effort only with tool and Stop events
evidence: spike: Haiku 5.5 and low within seconds of start, high after /effort high and Sonnet 5.5 after /model sonnet within 7 s each, his status line text unchanged

decision: refreshInterval 10 s for the wrapped status line
why: a /model or /effort typed in the terminal otherwise shows only after the next assistant message; his statusline.sh takes 0.06 s and calls nothing external

decision: a running session changes model and effort through /model <alias> and /effort <level> sent with send, only while idle or answered
why: these are Claude Code's own commands, so the terminal, claude.ai, and the status line all follow, with no hidden channel

decision: model and effort are shown, not stored
why: the next status line refresh restores them within 10 s of a hub restart
claude --help lists fable, opus, and sonnet as aliases, and the dialog offered only Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku
